patch_description:
This version restores a stronger input-aware repair-and-refill strategy. It begins from the supplied adjacency matrix, repeatedly deletes edges that participate in the largest number of common-neighbor violations, then greedily saturates the repaired graph using exact bitset C4 tests.

Several independently tie-broken repairs are retained in a small beam. Each beam state is subjected to bounded ruin-and-refill moves that delete structurally expensive edges and greedily refill using balanced low-degree endpoint choices. Every addition is checked using the exact condition that no edge may connect the two endpoint neighborhoods. Every major phase also explicitly verifies the common-neighbor invariant before accepting a candidate.
